label: Resistor-only qualification envelope; not observed circuit operating conditions
limitations: The2W figure is tied to measured terminal temperature, not ambient temperature; PCB copper must keep the terminal <=110C.
No reliance on published overload pulse curves: WFM p3 explicitly restricts them to33mohm;0.47ohm overload would need separate manufacturer qualification.

Actual UC8179 boost current threshold and waveform are not established; <=1A RMS / <=2A peak are proposed validation limits for resistor selection only. They do not increase the allowable limits of Q601,L601,diodes,controller or battery.
At higher current, higher terminal temperature or altered sense value, repeat selection/qualification.
Power calculations include initial resistance tolerance and component TCR but are not measured thermal performance.
